login.tagline: A private assistant wired into your world.
login.sentBody: If that address has access, the link is on its way. It expires in fifteen minutes.
login.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
login.invalidBody: It may have expired, already been used, or copied only in part. Request a new sign-in link.
login.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before requesting another link.
login.authUnavailable: Email sign-in isn’t available on this brain yet. Use an access token, or ask the founder to turn it on.
login.sessionFailed: Could not complete sign-in. Request a new link.
login.brainUnreachable: Could not reach Dialy. Check the brain URL and your connection.

empty.headline: All quiet. Nothing needed you today.
empty.sub: Dialy is watching. You’ll see it here when something needs a decision.

firstRun.headline: It doesn’t sleep, so you don’t have to.
firstRun.sub: Dialy watches the work, drafts the next step, and only asks when a decision is yours.

mail.title: Mail isn’t connected
mail.why: Dialy needs Gmail to draft or send on your behalf.
mail.next: Once mail is connected on the brain, try this again.

calendar.title: Calendar isn’t connected
calendar.why: Dialy needs calendar access to place time on your behalf.
calendar.next: Once calendar is connected on the brain, try this again.

github.title: GitHub isn’t connected
github.why: Dialy needs GitHub to draft a pull request.
github.next: Once GitHub is connected on the brain, try this again.

render.title: Render isn’t connected
render.why: Dialy needs Render to check or restart a service.
render.next: Once Render is connected on the brain, try this again.

telegram.title: Telegram isn’t connected
telegram.why: Dialy needs Telegram to reach you outside this app.
telegram.next: Once Telegram is connected on the brain, try this again.

access.title: Access
access.lede: An honest account of what Dialy can do for you right now — not a dashboard.
access.canDoEmpty: Nothing is connected yet. Dialy can still talk here; it cannot act outside this chat.
access.recentUnavailable: The activity log is not on this brain yet.
access.trustEmpty: Dialy still asks before it acts. That is the starting point, not a gap.
access.trustUnavailable: Trust history is not on this brain yet.
access.trustAutonomy: May act on its own for this
access.playbooksEmpty: No playbooks are loaded on this brain.
access.signedInLab: Signed in with an access token

approvals.awaiting: I've put this up for your approval below.

chat.binaryAttachmentSummary: {{size}} KB — binary; Dialy got the filename only.
chat.gotAttachment: Got it — what should I do?
chat.heresAttachment: Here’s the attachment you asked for.
chat.attachedReady: Attached {{name}} — send a message when ready.
chat.readyToSend: Ready to send with your next message.

share.title: Share into Dialy
share.pastePrompt: Paste text to share with Dialy
share.hint: Attachment joins the same chat session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.endpointHint: Primary endpoint for AI logic execution.
settings.export: Download a copy of your data
settings.exportHint: A file of what Dialy holds for this account.
settings.exportUnavailable: Data export is not on this brain yet.
settings.deleteWarn: This cannot be undone. Mail drafts, journal, and sessions for this account will be removed.
settings.deleteMismatch: That doesn’t match the email on this account.
settings.deleteUnavailable: Account deletion is not on this brain yet.
settings.deleteFailed: Could not delete the account just now.
settings.deleteNeedEmail: No email is on this session. Sign in with email to delete the account from here.

call.idleSub: Gujarati, Hindi, or English. The microphone is only used for this call.
call.reconnectingHint: Network dropped. Holding the call — this is not a crash.
call.endedHint: The call has ended. Chat is still here.
call.agentFailed: Dialy could not join. End and try again.
call.micWhy: The call needs the microphone so Dialy can hear you. Audio stays on the live call; you can mute at any time.
call.micDenied: Microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser address bar, then retry.
call.micUnavailable: No microphone was found on this device.
call.micBlockedLive: Microphone was blocked during the call. Allow it, then retry — you do not need to hang up.
call.tokenFailed: Could not start the call. Check that the voice worker and token server are running.
call.tokenRejected: The voice service rejected this session. Check the access token.
call.tokenInvalid: The voice service sent an unusable token.
